sentences.text: The Trial Court has annexed the statements of the parties in original , alongwith its report.
Learned State counsel too submits that there are no other accused other than the petitioners and respondent No.2 is the only aggrieved person in the FIR in question.

In view of the report of the learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Nihal Singh Wala and the principles laid down by Hon'ble the Apex Court in Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab and others (2012)
10 SCC 303, and also by the Full Bench of this Court in Kulwinder Singh and others Vs. State of Punjab and another, 2007(3) RCR (Criminal) 1052, the instant petition is allowed.
